summary: Startup logging helper for the VidMan (video manager) setup path: builds the debug message buffer via StringSplitLoop using the aDDevF119992002_26 path-prefix literal and, when that succeeds, emits an "entered VidMan" entry through DebugLogWrite. Always returns 0. Called by Game_Setup.

operations.description: Call StringSplitLoop(dword_8AD25C, 2, aDDevF119992002_26, 1012) to initialize the debug message buffer at dword_8AD25C with a formatted message built from the D:\Dev\F1 1999-2002... path-prefix literal; the literal 1012 is the buffer length bound and the literal 2 is a split/format parameter.
Guard on the StringSplitLoop return value: when it is non-zero the log entry is written; when zero the DebugLogWrite call is skipped.
On success, call DebugLogWrite(dword_8AD25C, aEnteredVidmanS) to write the 'entered VidMan' debug log message from the buffer to the log output.
Return 0 unconditionally at the end of the function.
Called by Game_Setup (0x0042D5D0) as part of the startup setup path.
